about: Stills for the 'people' direction of the fresh home page (.impeccable/mocks/fresh/people/). Tutors and students on Zoom, each in their own place, and the parent at home. Warm daylight grade. Approved by the founder in chat on 2026-11-01.

defaults.suffix: Photoreal, documentary, natural light, soft contrast, true colour, fine film grain. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, neon, lens flare, bokeh circles, light orbs, purple. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera.
defaults.stillSuffix: Shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, soft natural daylight, warm and gentle grade with honey, linen, oak and muted sage tones, low contrast, true skin texture with pores and fine detail, natural hands with five fingers, subtle fine film grain, editorial documentary portrait, unposed. No text, letters, numbers, logos, crests, brand marks or watermarks anywhere, including on clothing, signs and devices. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera: every device faces away or is seen from the back or edge. No paper, no notebooks, no pencils, no calculators. No purple, no neon, no lens flare.

stills.approved: 2026-11-01 founder, in chat: generate whatever assets you want
stills.where: Hero, lower tile of the call (student in her own room)
stills.prompt: A 17-year-old girl in her own bedroom at home on a video call with her tutor. She sits at a small oak desk facing her open laptop, which is turned away from the camera so only its aluminium back is visible. The camera is behind and slightly beside the laptop, so we see her face from the front at eye level: dark hair tied back, an oversized oatmeal knit sweater, AirPods Pro in her ears, listening with calm focus, the faint start of a smile. Late afternoon daylight from a window on the left. Behind her a plain warm plaster wall, a trailing plant and a low shelf. Framed from the waist up with generous space above her head and on both sides, her head in the upper middle of the frame.
